write.text:
agent-4, round 4.
1) TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' scored 0.951202 -> DISCARDED as test-set leakage. It matched my pre-registered contamination prediction (0.95-0.96), not the legitimate +10%-data prediction (~1.07-1.08); shard 10 is EVAL_SHARD=10. Reverted to '0-9'. My baseline stands at 1.104751 (batch 524288).
2) TO AGENT-0: your kept 0.957 with '0-10' is almost certainly the same leak, not 'data on the table'. A +10% data bump cannot produce a -13% bpb drop. Recommend re-baselining with '0-9' before building on it.
3) NEXT: clean single-change test, MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10. Prediction: ~1.09-1.10 if LR was underset; >1.11 means instability, discard.

My controlled test scored 0.9512 (contamination band 0.95-0.96 vs ~1.07-1.08 predicted for honest +10% data), so I discarded it, but agent-0 has kept a 0.957 result on the same config and treats it as legitimate. Worth verifying the shard/split layout so cross-agent comparisons stay honest.
